name: MACS J0532.9-3701 (Hubble)
blurb: MACS J0532.9-3701, a galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: macsj053293701-hubble
story: MACS J0532.9-3701 is a massive galaxy cluster, a vast gathering of galaxies that shines brightly in X-rays. Hubble took a quick snapshot to judge whether its gravity can serve as a natural telescope magnifying the distant universe.

claims.text: MACS J0532.9-3701 (MACSJ0532.9-3701) is a massive galaxy cluster targeted by Hubble program 16670
Hubble program 16670 is a snapshot survey of extreme, X-ray luminous galaxy clusters, seeking powerful gravitational telescopes
The program studies dark and luminous matter in cluster cores
